about: Gameplay potential of the first 100 ideas, 1-5 on each of: combat (how much, and how varied), enemies (variety and a ladder from common to boss), setpieces (memorable moments and escalation), systems (problems with several solutions that interact), lives (suits many lives in one persistent place). Scores are a judgement, not a measurement.

bigfoot-days: Festival crowd plus a stalker family; needs more enemy types (a rogue alpha, hunters who make it worse)
pale-watcher: Atmospheric, but one enemy and little to do about it
deepwater-lake: Water as a rule-based threat is good; one enemy
goat-sucker: Pack plus alpha, fair siege, nest raid: a solid ladder
hollow-mine: Swarm, specials and a queen, a mine to descend, explosives: one of the best
hunger-pass: Mimicry and cold are strong; one enemy
bayou-mouth: Flood plus creature plus gators; pumps as a lever
red-eyes-bridge: An omen, not a threat; little to play
harbor-titan: Kaiju above, spawn on the ground, a city to cross: high potential
under-tenements: Swarm, rat king, subway; blackout and flooding as tools
millbrook-flood: Great place and rescue play; no enemies at all
red-flag: Strong set pieces, nothing to fight
alley-season: Short and spiky; the tornado decides everything
the-wave: Eighteen minutes is too short for many lives
the-cascade: Drones, robot guards, doors and power as weapons: very systemic
the-forty-first: A vertical fire climb; no enemies
black-start: One saboteur; a mystery more than action
green-creep: Plant hazard as terrain; little fighting
turned: The full zombie ladder in a college town: top tier
the-sleep: Fatigue meter is a fresh rule; one enemy
spores: Caves, fire as a counter, hosts and blooms
the-rage: Lots of fighting, one enemy type
the-flock: Outdoors is deadly: a strong rule, one enemy
the-bite: Werewolf plus wolves, infection, full moon timing
mutation-pit: Mutants and brutes in a steel town
the-cure-run: A gauntlet across a quarantined city with patrols
ash-river: Built and proven; hordes need more types
copies: Paranoia and blood tests; a talking game
walkers: Tripods and drones over a city; take one down from below
under-the-ice: Blood test and flamethrower; one creature
hatchery-mall: Brood in a mall: siege, vents, fire, a big one
the-rift: Spawn from another side, power and portals
harrow-court: Built; light as the weapon; strong rules
hanging-hill: Witch spirit and possessed; ritual play
night-folk: Vampires: stakes, light, a master; good ladder potential
straw-men: Moves when unwatched: a good rule
the-deep-ones: Fish-folk siege on a hotel, a reef to blow
starfall-observatory: Cult assault during an eclipse; a boss
cellblock: Riot factions in a prison: good siege
occupied: Patrols, officers and dogs; sabotage and stealth
shelling: Sniper alley and shelling; mostly avoidance
north-pole: Elves, reindeer, a snow beast and Santa: a full ladder and a boss
toy-story-bad: Swarming toys with a mech; mall siege
dino-park: Pack, apex and spitters; power and fences as tools: top tier
the-convention: Robots, dogs and drones; EMP, server, doors
big-top: Clowns and a ringmaster; mirrors and fire
ferry-not-coming: Tide-driven crab horde: a good rule
